title: Large-scale expression and purification of biotinylated Enterovirus
author: Michael Fairhead
materials: Leave the sample at 00:30:00 Room temperature .

Concentrate to 10 mg/mL using a 10,000 MWCO centrifugal filter (Amicon, Merck-Millipore) and inject the sample (5 mL) onto 125 mL superdex 200 pg column pre-equilibrated in Base Buffer. Run the samples at a flow rate of 1 mL/min and collect 2 mL fractions. Only the peak eluting around 88 mL contains the target protein.

Pool the peak fraction(s) (e.g. 21-31 in the chromatogram below) and concentrate to 10 mg/mL using a 10,000 MWCO centrifugal filter (Amicon, Merck-Millipore) Snap freeze protein using liquid nitrogen as 0.1 mL aliquots and store the sample at -80°C until use Approximate final yield is 55 mg
Mass spectrometry of final sample to confirm biotinylation

steps.title: Transform and Plate Bacteria
steps.instruction: Transform BL21 (DE3) cells with the plasmid (Human Coxsackievirus A16 strain G10 2A protease with non-cleavable C-terminal His AviTag, Addgene #228634) and accessory plasmid pCDF-BirA.

substeps.instruction: Spread transformation mix onto LB-agar plates containing 50 μg/mL kanamycin and 50 μg/mL streptomycin.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate several colonies into 10 mL of superbroth containing 1% glucose, 50 μg/mL kanamycin, and 50 μg/mL streptomycin in a 50 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C and 250 rpm for 16 hours.

steps.title: Scale-up Culture and Initial Growth
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 L AIM-TB containing 50 μg/mL streptomycin, 50 μg/mL kanamycin, and 0.01% Antifoam 204 in a 2.5 L Ultra Yield baffled flask with an AirOtop enhanced flask seal using 10 mL of the starter culture.

substeps.instruction: Grow at 37 °C and 250 rpm for 4 hours.
Grow at 18 °C and 250 rpm for 1 hour.

steps.title: Harvest and Freeze Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the culture by centrifugation at 4000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Scrape out the pellet (approx. 45 g/L wet weight) and place it in a plastic polygrip bag.
Store the bag in a -80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce the culture by adding 1 mL of 500 mM D-Biotin (dissolved in 100% DMSO) and 1 mL of 100 mM IPTG.

substeps.instruction: Grow at 18 °C and 250 rpm for 22 hours.

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Place the polygrip bag on a flat surface, smash the cell pellet into small pieces, and transfer it into a 500 mL beaker.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL Base Buffer (10 mM HEPES, 500 mM NaCl, 5% Glycerol, 0.5 mM TCEP, pH 7.5) per gram of cell pellet.
Add 0.5 mg/mL Lysozyme, 1 µg/mL Benzonase or 10 µg/mL DNase I, 1% Triton X-100 (or substitute IGEPAL CA-630, Tergitol 15-S-9, Tween-20, or octyl glucoside), 30 mM Imidazole, and 0.5 mM D-Biotin.
Use a stripette to dissolve the pellet and transfer the mixture into four 50 mL tubes (maximum 45 mL per tube).

steps.title: Freeze-Thaw and Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Process the resuspended cells to release protein and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in a -80 °C freezer for 2 hours or overnight.
Thaw in a room temperature water bath for 1 hour and mix.
Centrifuge at 4000 x g for 1 hour at 4 °C.

steps.title: IMAC Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the protein using a His GraviTrap column (Cytiva) fitted with a LabMate PD-10 Buffer Reservoir, pre-equilibrated in Base Buffer containing 30 mM Imidazole.

substeps.instruction: Apply supernatant from two 50 mL tubes to the column.
Wash with 20 mL Base Buffer containing 30 mM Imidazole; repeat the wash 3 times in total.

steps.title: Desalting and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform on-column desalting using a PD-10 desalting column (Cytiva) pre-equilibrated in Base Buffer without Imidazole.

substeps.instruction: Slot the His GraviTrap column into the PD-10 desalting column.
Elute protein using 2.5 mL of Base Buffer containing 500 mM Imidazole directly onto the PD-10 column.
Remove the His GraviTrap column.
Wash the PD-10 columns with 50 mL to 100 mL of Milli-Q water.
Place the PD-10 desalting column into a 50 mL falcon tube, add 3.5 mL Base Buffer without Imidazole, and collect the flow-through.

steps.title: Column Regeneration and Storage
steps.instruction: Clean and store the IMAC columns.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 40 mL Milli-Q water.
Wash with 10 mL 1 M NaOH.
Wash with 40 mL Milli-Q water.
Wash with 10 mL 1 M Acetic Acid + 1% Triton X-100.
Wash with 40 mL Milli-Q water.
Wash with 10 mL 20% Ethanol + 0.1 M EDTA (dispose of nickel waste in appropriate container).
Wash with 40 mL Milli-Q water.
Wash with 0.5 mL 100 mM Nickel Sulfate + 20 mM Tris.HCl pH 8 (dispose of nickel waste in appropriate container).
Wash with 40 mL Milli-Q water.
Store columns in water at 4 °C, or use 20% Ethanol for long-term storage.
